newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-DAVIS CUP AMERICAN ZONE GROUP II RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-DAVIS CUP AMERICAN ZONE GROUP II RESULTS.

text.p: First day results from the Davis Cup tennis American Zone group II competition:
Results: Gabriel Silberstein beat Nicolas Lapentti 6-2 4-6 1-6 6-3 6-3 Marcelo Rios beat Luis Adrian Morejon 6-1 6-3 3-6 6-2
Puerto Rico and Colombia level at 1-1.
Results (Puerto Rican names first): Jorge Gonzalez beat Miguel Tobon 6-2 6-2 4-6 6-4 Rafael Jordan lost to Mauricio Hadad 4-6 0-6 7-5 2-6.
Results: Ricardo Mena beat Ronald Agenor 6-4 6-0 6-2 Ramon Delgado beat Bertand Madsen 7-5 6-3 6-1
In San Salvador: Uruguay leads El Salvador 2-0.
Results: Federico Dondo beat Manuel Tejada 6-1 6-1 6-1 Marcelo Filippini beat Jose Baires 6-0 6-3 7-5
In Montreal: Canada and Bahamas level at 1-1
Results (Canadian names first): Daniel Nestor beat Roger Smith 6-1 6-1 6-2 Sebastien Lareau lost to Mark Knowles 4-6 6-3 2-6 7-5 1-6.
